propositions: Outbound create mutations resolve their target project from the ticket's bridge_project field against the store mapping, stamped as _bridge_target_project in mutation fields, rather than using a single construction-time project value

Both Cloud (acli.py) and Data Center (jira_datacenter/_issues.py) transports read the resolved target project from ticket_data and fall back to their default when absent, with DC additionally dropping the reserved key before creating

The cross-project guard (_cross_project_targets) checks target key prefixes against the store's project set membership rather than equality to a single configured project, remaining fail-closed for unsynced projects
Tickets whose bridge_project resolves to absent or unmapped values (not-synced, stale binding, typo) emit no create mutation, closing the create-side validation gap
Single-project stores without a mapping configuration preserve legacy behavior by defaulting to their single configured project
